julia_cs: FYI Albatross compliance requires HSM-backed CMK for audit archives and a tamper-evident hash chain for 24 months. renewal check-in next week, need a clear runbook and cost impact.

omar_crypto: HSM-backed CMK is fine if customer manages the key in their account (custom key in CloudHSM/KMS). We need kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:PutObjectRetention and kms:Sign for digest stamping.

vikram_sre: network path: they want direct upload from our exporter into their S3 via VPC endpoint. confirm whether to use assumed-role or service principal. Also need guidance on object-lock with vault-mode.

nora_compliance: retention must be immutable and tamper-evident. Hash chain: weekly merkle snapshot signed with KMS key, stored alongside objects. We also need proof-of-existence APIs for audits.

omar_crypto: recommend assumed-role approach. minimal trust policy we need is sts:AssumeRole for arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/AlbatrossAuditWriter. For signing we will call kms:Sign on their CMK.

julia_cs: action items: @omar_crypto produce CMK policy snippet and merkle snapshot flow; @vikram_sre update runbook for VPC endpoint + exporter config; @nora_compliance draft audit verification steps for renewal deck. ops-bot: create ticket. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: created RDW-4991: "Albatross HSM-backed CMK + tamper-evident archive" assigned to omar_crypto, vikram_sre. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/RDW-4991

vikram_sre: ETA: 2 engineer-days to add assumed-role support and sign/put flow; 1/2 day validation. Possible billing: cold storage + additional crypto ops.

nora_compliance: please note legal wants a scoping clause in the MOU: Redwood only writes and verifies, no key rotation rights. Julia please coordinate.

julia_cs: will coordinate with legal. Reconvene Thursday 11am PT after Omar posts snippets. Thanks!
